name: Wildeben
kurzbeschreibung:
**Wildspitze in Tirol** – where the Alps reach their highest point in Austria. Discover the breathtaking **Wildspitze** (3,768 m), the crown of the **Ötztal Alps**, and the stunning **Venter Kofel** (3,509 m). Hike through untouched nature, marvel at glaciers, and enjoy panoramic views from the **Hochjochpass** or the **Wildspitze summit**.

In **Hintertux**, the highest village in the Alps, experience the unique charm of the **Tuxer Alps**. Whether you're skiing in winter or hiking in summer, this region offers unforgettable adventures.

**Innsbruck**, the vibrant capital of **Tirol**, is just a short drive away. Explore its historic old town, indulge in **Tiroler Gröstl** or **Kaiserschmarrn**, and enjoy the lively atmosphere of the **Goldenes Dachl**.

From **Landeck** to **Imst**, the **Ötztal** and **Inntal** valleys invite you to explore traditional villages, charming mountain huts (**Hütten**), and world-class skiing at **Sölden** or **Ötztal**.

**Tirol** awaits – where adventure, culture, and alpine beauty come together!
